title: Chat/changes: all changes in created[], updated/destroyed always empty
description:
ChatChangesHandler always appends changed chat IDs to created[], leaving updated: [] and destroyed: [] empty. get_changes_since_ordered returns (id, changed_at_counter) tuples with no is_create flag. Any chat state change (e.g. last_message_at updated) appears in created instead of updated. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires distinguishing created vs updated. Clients that use this distinction will treat every state change as a new chat record.

Fix: the store layer needs to distinguish insert vs update events, or store a created_at_counter separately. This requires a schema change.
